===== easyeda skill --help (exit=0) =====
Inspect and update the easyeda-agent skill installed for your AI clients.

  easyeda skill status                 show installed skill dirs + versions vs latest release
  easyeda skill sync                   update present skill dirs to the latest release
  easyeda skill sync --version 0.9.0   pin a specific version

The daemon syncs installed Skill dirs to its own version on startup; development builds skip writes.
CODEX_HOME / CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR override the default client config roots.
To update the CLI binary as well, use `easyeda update` (skill sync included).
The connector .eext is NOT covered here (no sideload auto-update) — the daemon
logs a re-import notice when it detects a stale connector.

Usage:
  easyeda skill [flags]
  easyeda skill [command]

Available Commands:
  status      Show installed skill dirs, their versions, and the latest release
  sync        Update installed skill dirs to the latest release (or a pinned --version)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for skill

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda skill [command] --help" for more information about a command.
